scope: One attribution-only profile, no control or improvement comparison. Existing model references are used only for correctness.

helper.stopMethod: Finite step guards, profiler disconnect and ordinary process exit

diagnosticReads: Identical three digest reads and ordinary fixture reads; host recorder uses only the existing sim.advance return value.
sampleAttribution: Each recorded sample interval is clipped to the actual host/held monotonic interval; inclusive call paths overlap and cannot be added.
limitations: One profiled run; no performance-improvement or production/phone/FPS acceptance
Timing wrappers, host interval records, input driver and diagnostic copies contribute overhead
CPU profiler samples main-thread stacks; process CPU includes other process threads
No allocation timeline; stage memory and bounded diagnostic counts only
Asynchronous GC observer delivered zero entries; this is not zero-GC proof
